chart_policy: one vocal attack per syllable; RMS-VAD endings; holds bounded by next attack; repetition balance only for repeated vowel runs

density_policy.dense_500_ms: >2 attack groups collapsed to one representative arrow/hold
density_policy.dense_1000_ms: >3 remaining attack groups reduced to three spaced directions
density_policy.hard_subdivisions: removed when inside an existing vocal hold
density_policy.literal_submillisecond_offsets: treated as collisions, not independent attacks
